category_title: Average-level readers engaging in balanced discourse
scenario_title: Justifying claims about the author's message
minimal_context: The student is identifying the author's message in a book about a boy and chocolate during a one-on-one reading conference.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What is the author's message in this book about the boy and the chocolate?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I think the author’s message is, um, you should ask permission before you get something.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well, his mom said he’s not allowed to eat any more chocolate.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He just kept eating chocolate over and over until he went to the doctor's and they said he had a chocolate disease. I don't know how else to explain the message.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: What is the author's message in this book about the boy and the chocolate?

STUDENT: I think the author’s message is, um, you should ask permission before you get something.

TUTOR: Okay. Anything else?

STUDENT: Well, his mom said he’s not allowed to eat any more chocolate.

TUTOR: Go on.

STUDENT: He just kept eating chocolate over and over until he went to the doctor's and they said he had a chocolate disease. I don't know how else to explain the message.

task.content: Identifying and justifying the author's message in a book about a boy and chocolate
task.learning_goal: support claims or opinions expressed in response to a previous question or to draw conclusions from the text

context.environment: one-on-one reading conference with Mrs. McCarthy (Grade 5)
context.materials: SEM-R bookmarks with sample higher-level and follow-up questions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When a student identifies a theme or author's message
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: states the message but requires encouragement to explain her thinking regarding the author’s message
related_quotes: I think the author’s message is, um, you should ask permission before you get something.

behavior_patterns.condition: When a student identifies a theme or author's message
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: expressed an opinion or claim without elaboration
